ourMission.title: Our Mission

list.item1: To understand the legacy of Borys Lyatoshynsky and other Ukrainian composers;
list.item2: To promote the inclusion of Ukrainian music in the global context;
list.item3: To support contemporary artists and create space for new meanings in music.

ourMission.imageCaption: Tetiana Homon and the Lyatoshynsky Foundation team

organisationText.text: — is a public organization created with the aim of making Ukrainian classical music of the XX–XXI centuries recognizable in the world.

aboutFoundation.mainText: We are named after Borys Lyatoshynskyi, one of the most influential composers in the history of Ukrainian music, a teacher, innovator, and one of the founders of the modern Ukrainian compositional school.
aboutFoundation.textImage: We know that Ukrainian academic music sounds loud and proud, on a par with other European and world cultures.

descriptions.descr1: We work with archives, scores, documents, and recordings to restore and organize cultural memory.
descriptions.descr2: We help contemporary composers, performers, and researchers realize their projects, find partners, audiences, and listeners.
descriptions.descr3: The Foundation not only preserves but also reconceptualizes — through contemporary performance practice, academic research, and dialogues between generations of musicians.
descriptions.descr4: We strive to share knowledge: for this purpose, we create educational products, lectures, and publications that reveal the richness of Ukrainian music to academic and general audiences.

descriptionsList.descr1: We organize concerts, festivals, and events that present the works of Borys Lyatoshynsky and other Ukrainian composers to a wide audience.
descriptionsList.descr2: We create educational projects that help understand the context of Ukrainian music and its significance in the world.
descriptionsList.descr3: We publish scores of Ukrainian composers, making them accessible to performers and researchers.
descriptionsList.descr4: We develop a museum space that preserves the memory of Borys Lyatoshynsky and showcases the history of Ukrainian music.
descriptionsList.descr5: We collaborate with musicians, researchers, and cultural institutions to promote Ukrainian music on a global scale.

foundation.foundationWasCreatedDescription: in 2023 by Tetiana Homon, Iryna Tukova, and Pavlo Piminov, brings together professionals in the fields of musicology, performing arts, music management, and digital projects.
